trigger.description: A search with --kind or --field filters widens its indexed candidate pool to 4096 without filling the matching quality-ranking pool or observing backend exhaustion. This applies independently to the workspace and admitted user-global lanes. The response may contain fewer matches than requested, including zero, without proving that no additional matching memories exist. Complete source exhaustion does not emit this warning.
setup_commands: # Index more than 4096 memories matching the query, with the desired kind/field matches ranked below the candidate ceiling.

expected_emission.repair_string: Use more specific query terms to bring matching memories into the bounded candidate pool.
